name: ryu.expect
description: Browser-based QA for agent code. Expect reads the current changes, creates a test plan, and runs it in a real browser with Playwright to catch regressions in behavior, performance, security, and design.

expect.description: Expect — test the current agent changes in a real browser with Playwright. Launched via `npx -y expect-cli@latest mcp`; requires Node.js and downloads the CLI on first use. Ask the agent to run the Expect workflow after making UI changes.
